05 / FAQ

Answers before you browse.

Where do the search results open?

Search sends your words directly to the FindSpreadsheet all-products search page.

Where do category cards go?

Each category card opens its corresponding FindSpreadsheet category page.

Is this the official LoloBuy website?

No. This is an independent research and discovery preview that sends visitors only to FindSpreadsheet.

Can I check product details first?

Yes. Use the Product details section to follow the research path before opening the main database.
